### Create a Campaign {slug: cold-email-agent/campaigns/create-a-campaign}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Cold Email Agent", then click "Create Campaign" (new campaign wizard).
- 4 steps: Name, Leads, Sequence, Finalization. Work autosaves; incomplete campaigns stay as Draft on Campaigns list.
- Before starting: need at least one Active/green-flame sending inbox, a target audience or list, and an angle (email method).
- Step 1: name the campaign, click Next, creates Draft.
- Step 2 Leads: Path A "Acquisity Lead Database" (AI-found, uses credits, ~1 credit/verified lead, default import 500, min 100) or Path B "Upload Your Own" (CSV, no credits). Checkbox "Launch campaigns automatically once the setup is complete" (on by default for AI leads; disabled for uploads). Lead search/upload takes 5-15 min in background; can leave page.
- Step 3 Sequence: choose AI Generated (default) or Create your own. Pick email method: Podcast (recommended), Interview, AI Business Audit, Direct. Masterclass method not available here. CSV uploads need target niche/role description. Generation takes 5-15 min. Review on Sequences tab: steps, subject/body, variants, delays, variables. Use Variables button, 2-4 vars/email ideal. Save edits before switching variants.
- Step 4 Finalization: pick sending inboxes (Active green-flame only; warming orange-flame hidden; all eligible selected by default), click "Create Campaign". Launch is async (few minutes).
- Success: progress screen completes, redirect to campaign detail page (~2s). Draft shows "Launch campaign" button if auto-launch off; Active if on. Sends start only within sending hours.
- Fixes: wizard error → reopen Draft from Campaigns list, resumes. Fewer leads than requested → unverifiable emails, check credits/contact support. Sequence >30min stuck → check job, retry, else contact support. Launch failed → select at least one Active inbox. Missing draft → clear Campaigns list filter.

## Who can do what

* Only the Owner role can change the workspace plan {slug: cold-email-agent/faq/lead-search/why-does-the-lead-limit-prompt-block-sending-when-i-have-leads-and-credits}.
* Owners and Admins can view the plan details, while Members can only compare plans and Clients cannot change the plan at all {slug: cold-email-agent/faq/lead-search/why-does-the-lead-limit-prompt-block-sending-when-i-have-leads-and-credits}.
* Only the Owner or Admin roles can see the campaign delete menu and delete campaigns; Members and Clients cannot see this option {slug: cold-email-agent/faq/campaigns/how-do-i-find-the-campaign-delete-menu}.
* The Client role can only see the AI SDR if their partner has enabled it {slug: ai-sdr}.
* The Client role cannot see the "Feedback" menu option to reach support {slug: support}.
* Only the Owner, Admin, and Member roles have full access to upload, analyze, export, and delete calls in the Sales Call Analyzer, whereas the Client role has no access and can only see the Client Portal {slug: sales-call-analyzer/faq/can-my-team-members-access-sales-call-analyzer}.
* Role types cannot be edited after an invitation is sent; a user must be re-invited to have their role changed {slug: sales-call-analyzer/faq/can-my-team-members-access-sales-call-analyzer}.
* Changing your account login email requires confirmation links to be completed from both the current and the new inbox, and your login remains the old email until both confirmations are done {slug: account-settings}.
* The account menu's "Edit sidebar" option is hidden for users in the Client role {slug: account-settings/faq/how-do-i-sign-out-of-acquisity}.
* Clients see only their own workspace and branding, and can never see the Partner Panel {slug: white-label-partners}.
* Only invited partner operators can see and access the Partner Panel {slug: white-label-partners/partner-admin}.
* Clients cannot see other client workspaces, overall billing, or other clients' data {slug: white-label-partners/partner-admin}.
* Only Owners and Admins can invite a client to an existing workspace, and the client must sign in with the exact email that was invited {slug: white-label-partners/users-workspaces}.
* Control of client app visibility must be managed via the Partner Panel features page, and clients should not be elevated to the Member role as a workaround {slug: white-label-partners/users-workspaces}.
* Owners and Admins can edit workspace-level settings, Members can only view settings, and Clients cannot see settings at all {slug: workspace-settings}.
* Only the Owner can grant the Owner role to another user, and a sole Owner is blocked from demoting their own role {slug: workspace-settings/members}.
* Admins can change Admin, Member, and Client roles, but they cannot change or create Owners {slug: workspace-settings/members}.
* Only the Owner can view and manage the workspace Billing page; Admins, Members, and Clients cannot access it {slug: workspace-settings/billing}.
* Workspace-wide default settings can only be edited by Owners and Admins; Members only have view-only access {slug: workspace-settings}.
* Only Owners and Admins can rename a workspace {slug: workspace-settings/faq/workspace-management/how-do-i-rename-a-workspace}.
* Only Owners and Admins can reset the workspace onboarding {slug: onboarding}.
* The Client role has a read-only portal view showing only 30-day cold email dashboard stats and the AI Account Manager chat, with no access to settings, billing, or credits {slug: client-portal}.
* Standalone tools under Resources are hidden entirely for the Client role and for workspaces that have no Resources tools enabled {slug: resources}.

## What Acquisity cannot do

* The platform cannot regenerate sample dashboard data once it has been cleared {slug: dashboard}.
* The dashboard pipeline performance section cannot show a kanban view, as it is strictly a funnel chart; the actual pipeline is managed under CRM Deals {slug: dashboard}.
* The Cold Email Agent cannot be accessed from the sidebar if the feature is disabled, if it is an ads-only workspace, or if the workspace is on a Legacy Pro plan {slug: dashboard/faq/where-are-my-campaigns}.
* The platform does not support workspace-wide bounced email exports; you can only export bounced emails one campaign at a time from the campaign Leads tab {slug: dashboard/faq/where-do-i-find-my-bounce-rate-and-bounced-emails}.
* The CRM does not support any native synchronization with GoHighLevel, Salesforce, HubSpot, or Pipedrive {slug: crm/faq/does-acquisity-integrate-with-gohighlevel-ghl-crm}.
* The CRM does not support automatic deal stage progression or automatic transitions to Closed Won/Lost, which must always be moved manually by a human {slug: crm/faq/does-the-ai-sdr-update-crm-deal-stages-automatically}.
* The CRM does not support a "reset all" button to clear pipelines or bulk-delete deals; deals must be opened and deleted one by one {slug: crm/faq/how-do-i-reset-my-crm-pipeline-delete-deals}.
